Hi @eng-41, here are the notes from my handover: House style keeps minor words visible but in lower case: when one of a, an, for, in, of, on, the, to appears anywhere except as the first word, its letter is kept lowercase. Example: 'Department of Defense' -> 'DoD', 'The Lord of the Rings' -> 'TLotR'.
